title: Fallout 3 Janus Bear — James_A / James_B Teddy-Gnome Placer Hypothesis Gate
question: Could the recurring teddy/gnome tragedy tableaux be explained diegetically as placements made by James, including the conditional James_B reconstructed by the SAVE JAMES protocol?

shipped_route_2277: Rivet City / Jefferson Memorial during The Waters of Life
JAMES_A.long_term_constraint: After Catherine's death in 2258 James withdraws to Vault 101 with the child and remains there until leaving in 2277.
JAMES_A.reason: The confirmed route does not establish travel to the broad teddy/gnome tableau set, and no shipped James-to-teddy/gnome staging edge has been identified.

JAMES_B.definition: conditional compatible synth host carrying a James-derived pre-exit Vault 112 autobiographical memory layer
JAMES_B.temporal_advantage: Could in principle exist after the biological death of James_A and therefore is not automatically bounded by James_A's terminal Project Purity event.
JAMES_B.reason: SAVE JAMES provides a conditional identity-continuity architecture, not a shipped route, travel history, object-placement record, or access authority for James_B.

known_discriminator_scenes.grammar: teddy + miniature intact gnome + miniature TV + cigarettes + shot glass + vodka
known_discriminator_scenes.rule: A hypothetical James_B may not receive Zeta access for free; a separate access edge is required.

known_discriminator_scenes.grammar: two teddy bears tied to rails + Help Us sign + intact gnome holding camera
known_discriminator_scenes.world_boundary: Broken Steel area; player access locked before Who Dares Wins

known_discriminator_scenes.grammar: damaged gnome in crate apparently watching a teddy bear drown
garden gnomes exist inside Braun's simulation and one participates in the failsafe activation sequence
known_discriminator_scenes.significance: This is the strongest direct James/gnome co-presence node, but co-presence under Braun's authored simulation does not establish James as gnome placer.

evidence_currently_for_hypothesis: James is strongly associated with the child/family/protection axis through Catherine and the Lone Wanderer.
James is physically present in Tranquility Lane where garden gnomes are part of the simulated scene language.
The conditional SAVE JAMES protocol creates a logically possible post-Vault112 James_B actor whose biological lifetime need not end at Project Purity.
The teddy grammar independently maps to child/comfort/absence themes that overlap James's biography.
evidence_currently_against_or_missing: No reviewed shipped record binds James to placing, carrying, arranging or collecting teddy bears as a recurring behavior.
No reviewed shipped record binds James to arranging garden gnome dioramas.
James_A's confirmed 2277 route is narrow compared with the geographically broad tableau distribution.
Mothership Zeta Robot Assembly requires an off-world access edge not established for James_A or James_B.
Point Lookout requires a cross-worldspace travel edge not established for James_A or James_B.
James_B itself is not a shipped vanilla actor and therefore cannot be used as evidence for vanilla authorship without circularity.
Developer-authored environmental storytelling already explains the existence of intentional tableaux without requiring one diegetic placer.

genesis_test_plan.name: GENESIS_JANUS_BEAR_JAMES_PLACER_FALSIFICATION
inputs: exact scene ledger with CELL/WRLD and DLC provenance
optional explicitly-authored James_B route ledger from a Genesis experiment; this must never be presented as vanilla evidence
metrics: fraction of teddy/gnome tableau cells intersecting confirmed James_A route cells
fraction requiring DLC-only or separate-worldspace access
number of scenes with explicit James object/script/dialogue edges
number of scenes with no James route edge
number of scenes requiring hypothetical James_B-only access
genesis_test_plan.hard_support_condition: At least one independent shipped record must explicitly bind James to a teddy/gnome placement or staging action; route overlap alone is insufficient.
genesis_test_plan.hard_rejection_for_single_actor: An exact scene is established to require a provenance/access path incompatible with both James_A and any non-circular admitted James_B route.

interpretive_note: The James_B idea is most scientifically useful as a falsifiable alternative to the default environmental-storytelling model. If it fails, it strengthens the multi-author visual-grammar interpretation; if a real James-specific placement edge is found, the hypothesis can be promoted for that bounded subset without generalizing to every bear or gnome.

next_gate.name: JAMES_TEDDY_GNOME_EXACT_REFID_ROUTE_AND_ACCESS_BINDING
targets: Extract exact placed RefIDs for all high-value teddy/gnome tableaux.
Bind each scene to canonical CELL/WRLD, plugin provenance, enabled state and quest gating.
Build a shipped-only James_A route ledger from quest/script references.
Search scripts/dialogue/inventory/ownership for explicit James↔teddy or James↔gnome edges.
Treat Mothership Zeta as an off-world access discriminator.
Keep any Genesis-created James_B route in a separate experimental namespace so it cannot back-propagate into vanilla evidence.
